teaser: Six claims from a post about The AI Conference traced to the slides, five open disagreements, and the best fact-check, in a speaker's notes.
core_idea: Reading the agenda, 35 slide decks with their notes and the abstracts of The AI Conference 2026 traces three of six claims in a GRC adviser's post to keynotes and finds no source for the other three; the programme's loudest idea is that policy must be enforced outside the model, its commonest story is the quiet failure, and its speakers disagree on humans in the loop, model or rule, inventories, probes and open models.
